description:
What is This Part?
This is the Intermediate Drive Shaft, #1 Propeller, that goes from the Transmission to the Transfer Case.
FITS ALL MODELS from 1986 thru 1995.
Large and Small Bolt Pattern Flanges Included.
Simply install the Flange you require on Drive Shaft.
Suzuki OEM Drive Shaft
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Intermediate Drive Shaft
Qty 1 – Small Bolt Pattern Flange 1985 – 1989
Qty 1 – Large Bolt Pattern Flange 1990 – 1995
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Small Flange – Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1989 All Models
Large Flange – Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 All Models
